english_title: Recognising and Responding to Choosing a Simple Food
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: food & drink — choosing a simple food
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to choosing a simple food; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan offers Ms Olivia a choice between bread and eggs for breakfast.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan mời chị Olivia chọn giữa bánh mì và trứng cho bữa sáng.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Olivia, would you like bread or eggs for breakfast?
turns.vietnamese: Olivia này, chị muốn ăn bánh mì hay trứng cho bữa sáng?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Eggs. I will make them now.
turns.vietnamese: Trứng nhé. Tôi làm ngay đây.
